description: V5 — negative vectors (tampering) over V2/V3 (B2 §2.8). Any conformant verifier MUST reject V5a/V5b pointing at the exact sequence, and MUST NOT flag V5c.

v5a.description: altering one character of the V2 payload (#4821 → #4822) changes payload_hash, hence event_hash, hence breaks the chain from that point on

v5b.description: flipping one bit of the V2 signature makes Ed25519 verification fail

v5c.description: escape differences are NOT tampering: see canonicalization/v1c.json (same canonical form, same hash)
